notes.title: Possible Content Update, and 2nd Anniversary
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I have considered updating Geneticognito with some new stuff for a while. Which would mean a (free) update that generally improves the game, and possibly adds a few things.
Mainly, I've thought about upgrading the visuals, some of the music, physics, and dialogue. Just making it overall... Better.

Although I won't guarantee this, or promise any release date. All I can say is that I would like to do it, and it will hopefully come around eventually. I'm fairly busy with other projects, so if anything I'll slowly get through it when I'm not too busy.


Anyways, for a different (but related) subject... Geneticognito turned 2 years old last month. It feels like it's been barely a year, so time really flies.
Fortunately, I got the impression that most people who played Geneticognito also enjoyed the experience, which is awesome to me. It's a tiny game, and it's no masterpiece, but I like to think I made something enjoyable.

So, let me know if you're interested in this free update idea. If people want it, I just have more reasons to do it faster!
And for those of you who enjoyed Geneticognito, that "sequel" I've talked about is still coming, so you might have that to look forward to as well.

Oh and also, you can follow my work in our Discord: https://discordapp.com/invite/blobgames
Or on Twitter: https://twitter.com/FelixBlobDev

-Felix
